mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong supply-side activity and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong supply-side activity and accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and FEDFUNDS decreases, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
